headline: Arsenal's Martin Zubimendi denies wanting to leave amid Atlético Madrid links
description: Martín Zubimendi has denied he is considering leaving Arsenal in the January transfer window amid reported interest from Atlético Madrid.

headline: Liverpool should have had penalty against Arsenal for Alexander Isak tug - panel
description: Liverpool should have been awarded a penalty for the shirt-tug on Alexander Isak in their Premier League match against Arsenal earlier this month, an expert panel has said.

headline: Man United contact Mauricio Pochettino, Michael Carrick leads training - sources
description: Manchester United head coach Michael Carrick is set to take training again on Wednesday as he waits for news on his future, with the club in contact with Mauricio Pochettino, sources have told ESPN.

headline: How Harry Kane rose to win Ballon d'Or and became an England legend
description: Harry Kane went from overlooked youngster to Ballon d'Or winner. Now he's about to become England's record appearance-holder -- and possibly their greatest-ever player.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Man United add Brentford defender Nathan Collins to shortlist
description: Brentford center back Nathan Collins has been added to Manchester United's list of defensive options. Transfer Talk has the latest.
